es.title: Rain in a Tokyo Street 8 Hours 🌃 Sleep, Study and Relax
es.description:
8 hours of gentle rain falling on a quiet Tokyo street at night for deep sleep, focused studying, or pure relaxation. An immersive sound that transports you to the neon-lit calm of Japan's capital.

🌃 What you'll find in this video:
- 8 uninterrupted hours of city rain
- Soft rain on rooftops and streets
- No music, no voice, just pure ambience
- Immersive Tokyo night atmosphere

✅ Perfect for:
✔ Sleeping deeply all night
✔ Studying or working with maximum focus
✔ Relaxing after a long day
✔ Meditating or practicing mindfulness
✔ Blocking unwanted outside noise

🔔 Subscribe for more relaxing nature and city sounds.

⏱️ Duration: 8 hours | 📺 Full HD 1080p
